events.title: Check out our demo in this Next Fest! 🐚
events.summary: Hello friends! Just popping by quickly today to say our Sandcastle demo is included in Steam Next Fest which has just kicked off! Be sure to check it out, get creative, and share your builds with us! We can’t wait to see what you get up to. We have some very exciting news on the way soon so keep your eyes peeled for more announcements 👀 -Bubblebird Studio

events.title: Demo 0.31.0 Patch
events.summary: Hi!The first patch for Sandcastle Demo is available! The main improvement is the water simulation: digging holes won't make water appear from nowhere anymore, and in general, the amount of water stays much more stable now!I've also reduced the speed at which the sand collapses by default! The sun intensity and clouds will now also affect how quickly the sand dries.Here is the full list of changes:Improved: Removed cursor toggle hotkey, changed HUD visibility toggle hotkey to F8Fixed: Water simul

events.summary: Hi everyone!
